build.name: make
build.cmd: make -s 2>&1 | grep -viE 'warning' | tail -3; ls viterbi viterbi_test 2>/dev/null; test -x ./viterbi_test || test -x ./viterbi

runs.name: the shipped Viterbi/HMM test
runs.cmd: ./viterbi_test 2>&1 | tail -10 || make test 2>&1 | tail -10; echo VITERBIDONE

notes: viterbi_test is the upstream oracle: decode a known HMM's observation sequence and check the most-likely path. behavioral_entry_point: perturb transition/emission probabilities.
